d:
The Cavaliers defeated the Bucks, 136-111 tonight in Milwaukee. Evan Mobley finished with a team-high 27 points along with 5 rebounds and 3 assists for the Cavaliers, while Jarrett Allen tallied 25 points, 11 rebounds and 4 assists in the game. Kel'el Ware recorded 19 points, 10 rebounds and 3 assists. The Cavaliers improve their record to 4-2 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-5 for the season.
